project.name: cargotracker
project.description: Django-based cargo tracking application structured with domain-driven design (cargo and handling bounded contexts).

nodes.name: map_status.py
nodes.summary: Application-layer helper that maps a cargo's state to a status code for the tracking map.

nodes.name: map_status_code
nodes.summary: Translates a Cargo into a status code string consumed by the map view.

nodes.name: tracking.py
nodes.summary: Application service that looks up cargos by tracking ID and retrieves their handling history through repositories.

nodes.name: TrackingLookup
nodes.summary: Query service wrapping the cargo and handling-event repositories to find a cargo and its handling history.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root wiring the Django repositories and TrackingLookup service into the tracking view.

nodes.name: compose_tracking_view
nodes.summary: Builds the tracking view with concrete Django repository implementations injected.

nodes.name: cargo.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Cargo aggregate root of the domain with type validation and identity-based equality on tracking ID.

nodes.name: Cargo
nodes.summary: Cargo entity aggregating tracking ID, route specification, delivery and itinerary; equality and hashing are by tracking ID.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Declares the CargoRepository protocol (port) for persisting and querying cargos.

nodes.name: CargoRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol with upsert, find and find_all operations for cargo persistence.

nodes.name: tracking_id.py
nodes.summary: Defines the immutable TrackingId value object identifying a cargo.

nodes.name: TrackingId
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass wrapping a string tracking ID, validating its type.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django form for entering a cargo tracking ID with a required-field message and styled input widget.

nodes.name: TrackingForm
nodes.summary: Form with a single stripped tracking_id CharField styled with Tailwind/daisyUI classes.

nodes.name: eta.py
nodes.summary: Formats a cargo's estimated time of arrival for display.

nodes.name: format_eta
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable ETA string derived from the cargo's delivery.

nodes.name: adapter.py
nodes.summary: Adapter producing the embedded map frame URL for a cargo using its map status code.

nodes.name: map_frame_url
nodes.summary: Builds the URL of the tracking map iframe for a given cargo.

nodes.name: next_activity.py
nodes.summary: Renders a cargo's next expected handling activity as display text.

nodes.name: get_next_activity_text
nodes.summary: Converts a HandlingActivity into descriptive text for the tracking page.

nodes.name: status_text.py
nodes.summary: Generates the cargo status sentence, distinguishing in-port and onboard-carrier states.

nodes.name: get_status_text
nodes.summary: Returns status text for a cargo based on its delivery transport status.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Defines the tracking view factory that handles the tracking form, looks up cargo and renders full or HTMX partial templates.

nodes.name: create_tracking_view
nodes.summary: Returns a Django view closure that validates the tracking form, loads cargo and history, and renders the result with status, ETA, map and history context.

nodes.name: process_registration_attempt.py
nodes.summary: Application use case that claims handling registration attempts, resolves them into handling events, updates cargo delivery, and retries with backoff on temporary failures.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses exponential backoff capped at 60s and defers outcome logging until the atomic transaction exits.

nodes.name: process_registration_attempt
nodes.summary: Public entry point looping over single-attempt processing, retrying temporary failures with exponential backoff and logging after prolonged failure.

nodes.name: _process_registration_attempt_once
nodes.summary: Within a transaction claims the next attempt, stores the handling event, recomputes cargo delivery and marks the attempt registered or rejected.

nodes.name: _resolve_event
nodes.summary: Resolves the cargo, location and voyage for an attempt and builds a HandlingEvent, raising a permanent failure when invalid.

nodes.name: _resolve_location
nodes.summary: Looks up a Location by UN/LOCODE, converting UnknownLocation into a permanent failure.

nodes.name: _resolve_voyage
nodes.summary: Looks up an optional Voyage by number, converting UnknownVoyage into a permanent failure.

nodes.name: _PermanentRegistrationFailure
nodes.summary: Internal exception carrying a reason code and message for non-retryable registration rejections.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: Root Django URL configuration routing the tracking page, handling report REST endpoint and map URLs.

nodes.summary: Django ORM records (CargoRecord, LegRecord) persisting the cargo aggregate, its route specification and itinerary legs.

tour.title: Project Overview: Cargo Tracking in DDD
tour.description: Cargotracker is a Django app modelled with Domain-Driven Design around cargo, handling, location and voyage bounded contexts. The handling glossary defines the ubiquitous language used throughout the code.

tour.title: Entry Points and Configuration
tour.description: The ASGI/WSGI modules expose the Django application; settings configure it and urls.py routes the tracking page, map frame and handling reports.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate and Value Objects
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate root is built from value objects: TrackingId, RouteSpecification, Itinerary, Leg, Delivery and HandlingActivity. Dates are normalised to UTC.

tour.title: Handling Events Domain
tour.description: Handling events record what happened to cargo (receive, load, unload, claim); HandlingHistory wraps them and registration attempts model queued reports.

tour.title: Locations and Voyages
tour.description: Location (UN/LOCODE) and Voyage (schedule of carrier movements, with a builder) round out the domain.

tour.title: Repository Ports
tour.description: Domain-defined protocols declare persistence needs without depending on Django, enabling hexagonal architecture.

tour.title: Application Services
tour.description: Use cases orchestrate the domain: tracking lookup, accepting handling reports, processing queued attempts and seeding sample data.

tour.title: Infrastructure: ORM and Repositories
tour.description: Django ORM records and repository adapters implement the ports; models.py shims let Django discover them, and migrations define the schema.

tour.title: Composition Roots
tour.description: Composition modules wire concrete repositories into services and views, keeping dependency injection out of the domain.

tour.title: Tracking Web Interface
tour.description: The tracking view handles the form, looks up cargo and renders status, ETA, next activity and history via presentation helpers and htmx templates.

tour.title: Templates and Map Frame
tour.description: HTML templates form the htmx-driven page, and a Leaflet map frame shows cargo locations.

tour.title: Handling REST API and Management Commands
tour.description: External systems submit handling reports over REST; queued attempts are processed asynchronously by a management command, and sample data can be seeded.
